alerts.title: Prescribed Fire Operations are Underway near Beaver Meadows Visitor Center
alerts.description: Ignitions on today's operation on the Headquarters Unit of the Front Country Prescribed Fire have been completed. Fire personnel will continue to patrol and will remain on site overnight. U.S. Highway 36 in Rocky Mountain National Park is open. Smoke will continue to linger. As temperatures cool overnight, smoke may settle in low-lying areas in the immediate vicinity near Beaver Meadows Visitor Center.

alerts.title: Trail Ridge Road Status Update
alerts.description: Trail Ridge Road is closed to through travel. The road is closed at Many Parks Curve on the east side of the park and at Colorado River Trailhead on the west side. For the latest information on the status of Trail Ridge Road, call 970-586-1222.
